verdict.rationale: No documentation addresses model training or offers a training opt-out. The only relevant evidence is indirect: Letta can run entirely on infrastructure you control, and local mode keeps all agent state (messages, memory, provider connections) on-device with no Letta account. That keeps data away from Letta, but prompts still go to whichever third-party model provider you use. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control for Letta Cloud, statements on training by model providers or BYOK data handling, and independent corroboration.
